title: Rank Stabilization for Sparse Coordinate Completion of Unit-Norm Tight Frames
summary: We determine generic completion-fiber dimensions for unit-norm tight frames when each partially observed column has exactly two missing coordinates. We work on the complex algebraic variety defined by the real frame equations. The missing coordinate pairs form a labelled multigraph. For every $d\ge4$ and every frame length $R\ge N_d:=\binom{d+1}{2}-1$, we prove that the missing-pair Jacobian matroid is the Rado matroid of an explicit subspace arrangement.
